subject: Runway gap scan: owner assignments & commit follow-ups
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T08:55:00-08:00
Subject: Runway gap scan: owner assignments & commit follow-ups

Team —

Attached is the latest runway gap scan (runway_gap_scan_Q4_v2.xlsx). Quick summary: based on current stages and my desk-check of forecasts we’re ~18% below target for Q4 on commit-able ARR. We need a short, practical sweep to lock stage changes, confirm committed dates, and surface any controllable plays that can recover coverage.

Ask (today):
- Karthik: take the lead on the three mid-market opportunities flagged in tab "Priority 1". Confirm stage (Proposal vs Commit) and next contact by EOD.
- Laura: own the enterprise cluster (rows 12–18). If procurement/legal needs an updated MAP, I’ve attached a template (DBL-4821_mutual_action_plan.pdf).
- Both: add direct notes in the sheet and flag any deals with >60% probability movement to "commit" within 21 days.

I’ll consolidate by 2pm PT and send a short handoff to Finance for runway modeling. If either of you want a quick 15-min sync, ping and I’ll slot it.

Attachments:
- runway_gap_scan_Q4_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, owner columns per account)
- DBL-4821_mutual_action_plan.pdf (template)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runway gap scan: owner assignments & commit follow-ups

On 2026-11-22 08:55, Hannah Schmitt wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached is the latest runway gap scan...

Thanks Hannah — I pulled the sheet and started populating notes. Quick readout:
- Cybele AI (DBL-4821): proposal sent 11/10, procurement looped but awaiting a legal redline on the DPA. I’ve added Beth Turner (procurement lead) contact in the notes and requested a final review by 11/25. I think commit likelihood is ~55% if legal returns clean.
- Nimbus Health: have a PO draft but finance asked to confirm SSO timeline (doing that today).
- Orion Labs: moved from "qualified" to "proposal" after pricing refresh — outreach scheduled tomorrow.

I’ll update the "Priority 1" tab with target next-contact dates and a one-line play (e.g., "legal escalation + MAP push").

Karthik
Director, Sales — MidMarket
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runway gap scan: owner assignments & commit follow-ups

Thanks — got it. I audited rows 12–18 and did a quick stage scrub:
- Midsouth Energy: procurement has an open question on data residency. I asked for the vendor questionnaire to be returned by 11/24.
- Aster Biotech: legal is onboard; commercial is finalizing internal approval — I set next contact for 11/24.
- Polaris Systems: looks weak; I recommend a conservative 30% for now.

I can join a 15-min if you want to walk accounts — I have 12:30–12:45 PT free.

Laura
Sr. AE, Enterprise
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Beth Turner <beth.turner@cybele.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Cybele AI — quick procurement ask and MAP

Beth — looping you in here to accelerate a small legal point so we can lock the Q4 commit. Hannah and Laura are on the runway sweep for coverage.

Short ask: can your legal team review the attached MAP (DBL-4821_mutual_action_plan.pdf) and confirm any redline items by COB 11/25? If you prefer, we can do a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the MAP and the implementation timeline.

We’ll mark a tentative commit date in the sheet once legal clears the MAP. Appreciate the quick turn.

—Karthik
From: Beth Turner <beth.turner@cybele.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cybele AI — quick procurement ask and MAP

Karthik/Hannah — thanks for the ping. I received the MAP and flagged one small clause for our counsel (data handling sub-section). I’ll push it through internal review and aim to get back with redlines or approval by 11/25 COB.

I can do a 20-min call tomorrow at 10am ET if that helps move things faster — let me know and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Beth Turner
Head of Procurement | Cybele AI
